description: Intent i007 (SNAPSHOT=s02, BRANCH=uninit-parse-outparam) complete. Two reported candidates, both verified by literal source reads. (1) drivers/infiniband/hw/mlx4/sysfs.c:78-99, store_admin_alias_guid(): uninitialized stack local u64 sysadmin_ag_val (line 78) is the out-param of sscanf(buf, "%llx", &sysadmin_ag_val) at line 88 whose return code is ignored; on a non-numeric userspace sysfs write the uninitialized stack value is consumed twice — stored into mdev->sriov.alias_guid.ports_guid[].all_rec_per_port[record_num].all_recs[...] (lines 89-92) and committed via mlx4_set_admin_guid() (lines 97-99) — plus state transition and alias-guid work scheduling, so garbage stack content becomes persistent GUID-table/device state that is later re-read and re-applied. This is the direct non-sysctl analogue of the seed's unchecked-parse-outparam -> unconditional-commit mechanism (uninitialized-value-to-persistent-state variant; sysfs node is root-writable, so classified medium confidence garbage-state rather than unprivileged disclosure). (2) drivers/scsi/scsi_transport_iscsi.c:3013-3018, iscsi_if_set_param(): sscanf(data, "%d", &value) at line 3015 ignores its return; session->recovery_tmo = value at line 3017 still executes on a failed parse, silently coercing the recovery timeout to 0 (value pre-initialized at 2998, so no stack leak) on CAP_SYS_ADMIN netlink input — low-confidence adjacent variant. Evidence-checked negatives: nla_parse*/nla_parse_nested return-ignoring sites in net/wireless/nl80211.c:12942 and net/wireless/pmsr.c:317 are safe because __nla_validate_parse() memsets the tb out-array in lib/nlattr.c before returning, and NULL-presence checks guard every use; CAN netlink bittiming memcpys (drivers/net/can/dev/netlink.c:474,624), ip_gre.c:1133, infiniband addr.c:100 all copy from policy-length-validated attributes with subsequent error gating; rbd.c:7246, pcie-designware-debugfs.c:330, hisi_sas_v3_hw.c:4504, ixgbe_debugfs.c:88, libie fwlog.c, greybus audio_manager_sysfs.c all check parse results or pre-initialize; net/socket.c:2451 unchecked copy_from_sockptr is a documented best-effort legacy path with the length re-validated in sockptr_to_sockopt. Limitations: bounded to idiomatic unchecked-parse patterns (no full per-function dataflow pass); mlx4 on-stack attacker influence over sysadmin_ag_val unmeasured; iscsi recovery_tmo consumers not fully traced; iwlwifi mld/debugfs.c:1056 left unresolved (strong safety evidence, caller analysis incomplete).
